out.title: HCL Technologies Q2 FY27 results: revenue ₹35,620 crore, EPS ₹70.22
out.summary: HCLTech reported Q2 FY27 results for quarter ended September 30, 2026: revenue ₹35,620 crore (+11.5% YoY), net income ₹5,132 crore (+21.2% YoY), EBIT margin 18.2%, dividend ₹12/share, FY27 CC revenue guidance 2.5-4.0%.
